## getContactSyncFilter

Hubspot Get Contact Sync Filter. `GET /integrations/hubspot/contact-sync-filter`

Read the persisted selective contact-sync filter. Returns the pre-feature default (mode = none — import everything) when nothing is stored yet.


- Scopes: `settings:read`

Returns `HubSpotContactSyncFilterModel`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/HubSpot%20Integration/hubspot_get_contact_sync_filter_api_v1_integrations_hubspot_contact_sync_filter_get)

## putContactSyncFilter

Hubspot Put Contact Sync Filter. `PUT /integrations/hubspot/contact-sync-filter`

Persist the selective contact-sync filter. The filter is VALIDATED against HubSpot on save (a HubSpot 400 surfaces its own limit message); persisting ALSO increments sync_generation so a sync run using the previous filter self-interrupts. Narrowing stops adding non-matching contacts but does not delete already-synced ones; widening does not auto-backfill (import is a separate explicit action).

```php
$result = $sendseven->hubSpotIntegration()->putContactSyncFilter(mode: 'mode');
```

- Scopes: `settings:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$mode` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$version` | `?int` | no |  |
| `$properties` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no |  |
| `$list` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no |  |
| `$updatedAt` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$updatedByUserId` | `?string` | no |  |

Returns `HubSpotContactSyncFilterModel`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/HubSpot%20Integration/hubspot_put_contact_sync_filter_api_v1_integrations_hubspot_contact_sync_filter_put)

## contactCount

Hubspot Contact Count. `GET /integrations/hubspot/contacts/count`

Count the connected HubSpot portal's contacts, optionally scoped by a draft filter (unsaved filter_groups) and/or a list_id — this powers the live "X contacts match" preview while a selective-sync filter is being edited. Backed by a HubSpot Search (POST /crm/v3/objects/contacts/search with limit:0) that returns the server-side total in ~0.3s; results are cached ≤5 min unless refresh=true.

```php
$result = $sendseven->hubSpotIntegration()->contactCount();
```

- Scopes: `settings:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$filter` | `?string` | no | URL-encoded filter_groups JSON (OR across groups, AND within). Omit filter AND list_id to count the whole portal. |
| `$listId` | `?string` | no | Count only this HubSpot list's members |
| `$refresh` | `?bool` | no | Bypass the ≤5-min server cache (live-preview edits) |

Returns `HubSpotContactCount`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/HubSpot%20Integration/hubspot_contact_count_api_v1_integrations_hubspot_contacts_count_get)

## listProperties

Hubspot List Properties. `GET /integrations/hubspot/properties`

List the connected portal's HubSpot contact properties — feeds the settings field-mapping dropdown (replacing free-text property inputs). Each item: name, label, type, field_type, group_name, custom.

Also returns targets: the mappable-target catalogue for the "Contact methods" and "Social media profiles" settings sections — {"contact_methods": [{"target": "email", "label": "Email (primary)"}, ...], "social_profiles": [{"target": "linkedin", "label": "LinkedIn"}, ...]}. Pair a HubSpot property (from items) with one or more of these targets to build the contact_method_mapping sent to PATCH /settings.

```php
$sendseven->hubSpotIntegration()->listProperties();
```

- Scopes: `settings:read`

Returns `void`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/HubSpot%20Integration/hubspot_list_properties_api_v1_integrations_hubspot_properties_get)

## createProperty

Hubspot Create Property. `POST /integrations/hubspot/properties`

Create a new custom HubSpot contact property so it can be selected inline in the field-mapping UI. Returns the created property in the same shape as the list endpoint.

NOTE: HubSpot requires the crm.schemas.contacts.write scope to create a property. If the connected portal did not grant it, this returns 400.

```php

```

- Scopes: `settings:update`

## previewSegment

Hubspot Preview Segment. `POST /integrations/hubspot/segments/{list_id}/preview`

Preview a segment's audience: resolve a sample of the HubSpot list live and report how many members map to existing contacts, how many would be auto-created, and how many are unresolved under the segment's policy.

Dry-run: this is non-mutating — it resolves and counts WITHOUT creating any link or contact (would_create is a projection, not an action). The real send/sync/cached-refresh paths still eagerly link and create.


Update sync direction toggles and/or field-mapping overrides.
